title: A Systematic Study of Deprecated Android API Usage Updates
abstract: arXiv:2610.19150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Android Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) continuously evolve, causing existing APIs to become deprecated and requiring developers to migrate their usages to recommended replacements. Although prior studies have proposed automated migration techniques, their effectiveness is often limited by the diversity and contextual complexity of API changes. This paper presents a systematic study of deprecated Android APIs, their recommended replacements, and real-world usage updates performed by developers. Based on an analysis of 1,000 deprecated APIs and 4,336 migration examples collected from GitHub, we identify six migration categories and derive recurring usage-update patterns involving Android-version checks, parameter adaptation, object initialization, data-type conversion, and changes in API interaction mechanisms. translated_title: 对已弃用Android API使用更新的系统性研究
translated_abstract: Android应用程序编程接口（API）持续演进，导致现有API被弃用，并要求开发者将其用法迁移到推荐的替代API上。尽管先前的研究已提出自动化迁移技术，但其效果往往受限于API变化的多样性和上下文复杂性。本文对已弃用的Android API、其推荐的替代API以及开发者在实际中所进行的使用更新开展了系统性研究。基于对从GitHub收集的1,000个已弃用API和4,336个迁移示例的分析，我们识别出六个迁移类别，并总结出反复出现的使用更新模式，包括Android版本检查、参数适配、对象初始化、数据类型转换以及API交互机制的变化。为评估这些模式的适用性，我们在零样本GUPPY基准提示中加入了迁移类别及对应的……
tldr: 本文通过分析1,000个已弃用Android API和4,336个来自GitHub的迁移示例，系统性地识别出六大迁移类别及反复出现的API使用更新模式，为改进自动化API迁移技术提供了实证基础。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic study of deprecated Android APIs and real-world migration practices, identifying six migration categories and recurring usage-update patterns from 1,000 deprecated APIs and 4,336 GitHub migration examples to inform automated API migration techniques.
